start.note: how the guard starts AutoCAD: 'auto' = through SOFiCAD's launcher if it is installed, else plain AutoCAD; 'soficad' / 'autocad' force one. The environment variable ACAD_GUARD_PROFILE overrides this.

autocad.note: acad_exe 'auto' = the newest Program Files\Autodesk\AutoCAD 20xx\acad.exe; give a path to pick another

note: titles and buttons in English and Russian: the Russian ones are from AutoCAD 2027 ru-RU (SECURELOAD seen live; the others from its resources AcTaskDialogs / acadres / AcRecoverall)

dialog_rules.name: SOFiCAD trial/licence notice (first load of the reinforcement modules)
dialog_rules.title: ^SOFiSTiK: Product Activation

dialog_rules.name: SOFiCAD assertion
dialog_rules.title: ^SOFiSTiK: Assertion failed
dialog_rules.note: never press Abort - it kills AutoCAD

dialog_rules.name: SECURELOAD: unsigned file
dialog_rules.title: ^(Security - Unsigned Executable File|Безопасность — исполняемый файл без подписи)

dialog_rules.name: missing references (xref/images)
dialog_rules.title: ^(References\b|Ссылки — )
buttons: Ignore the unresolved references and continue

dialog_rules.name: SOFiCAD 'new bar is similar to POS n - use it?' -> No (asks about the next similar mark, then creates the new one)
dialog_rules.title: ^SOFiSTiK$
dialog_rules.text: is similar to Rebar Bar POS

dialog_rules.name: SOFiCAD asks where its project database is (German template Sofstart.dwt; then again on document switches) -> Abbrechen (use Sofstart_enu.dwt)
dialog_rules.title: ^Position Projektdatenbank$

dialog_rules.name: AutoCAD crash / error report
dialog_rules.title: (?i)error report|fatal error|unhandled exception|error aborting|has stopped working|unexpected|неустранимая ошибка|прекращена работа
dialog_rules.note: the Russian title words are not seen live yet (a crash cannot be brought up on purpose)

dialog_rules.name: AutoCAD cannot continue - save a recovery copy (*_recover.dwg, original untouched)
dialog_rules.title: ^AutoCAD Alert$
dialog_rules.note: English only: the Russian title and text are not known yet
